products.name: Harvey AI
products.note: Legal AI assistant; contract drafting; case research; law firm data exposure; privilege concerns

profile_text.body:
Harvey is a San Francisco-based company that builds AI software for legal and professional services. According to its own site, the platform is designed for law firms and corporate legal teams and is used to streamline contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, and litigation work. The company describes itself as built to meet the standards of leading professional service firms and states that it publishes research findings and develops work alongside the open-source community.

The company's primary product is Harvey AI, a legal AI assistant that covers contract drafting, case research, and related workflows. The site notes that 2025 brought new customer wins, product updates, and expanded global presence, and it quotes Dr. Claudia Junker describing the platform as transforming how legal teams navigate complex issues and deliver strategic value.

The site's held facts flag 139 data exposure incidents linked to California, with noted concerns around law firm data exposure and legal privilege, which are relevant considerations for a product handling sensitive legal materials. Harvey holds a tracked presence on theworldofai.org under the Finance and Legal AI category, with its profile last verified in August 2026.
